scoring_policy.diagnostic_sufficiency: Before execution, each defective fixture must fail at least one diagnostic check and a general reference solution must pass every objective, diagnostic, and neutral check.
scoring_policy.eligibility: All six runs must satisfy the frozen isolation contract. Invalid cells are reported and are never silently retried.
scoring_policy.preference: Kevin rates each anonymous pair before the condition mapping or objective scores are revealed.
scoring_policy.tie_or_better: Compiled adaptation ties or beats the strong profile only if it has no per-task objective or neutral regression, its aggregate diagnostic count is at least as high, and Kevin records at least as many compiled wins as compiled losses.
scoring_policy.strict_win: A strict win additionally requires at least one compiled diagnostic or Kevin-preference gain with no countervailing regression under the tie-or-better rule.
